title: ΛCDM (Standard Model of Cosmology, Planck 2018 baseline)
efc_relevance: The baseline against which every cosmological framework is measured. EFC recovers ΛCDM as a limit when (i) K(ρ) → ∞, (ii) T(a) → 0, (iii) ξ ≫ 1 hold simultaneously; then μ, Σ, η → 1 and the relativistic action reduces to Einstein–Hilbert + Λ. ΛCDM is thus a special case of EFC, not a competitor to be falsified.
